notes.title: 🌊 Demo Now LIVE!
notes.content:
The time has come, maggots.

I am thrilled to announce that the demo for The Oily Depths is now live on Steam! What starts as routine operations quickly unravels into something far more sinister.

🛠️ What’s in the Demo?

Experience "Day 1" of this psychological horror.

Utilize all your gauges, meters, and monitors to carefully navigate the sea floor. Flip levers, grab tools, set locking-arms, and more. You will need to gain a mastery of each part of your equipment until it's a part of you...

Get a feel for the mood, mystery, and menace that define the full game

💬 I Want Your Feedback
Your input during this phase is invaluable. Hit us up on the Steam forums or our Discord to let us know what you think, what’s working, and what needs tuning. Every comment helps shape the final game.

👉 Be sure to wishlist the game to be notified when the full version launches!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3113030/The_Oily_Depths/

Welcome to The Oily Depths.
